import json, subprocess, sys

TOKEN = "<TOKEN>"
BASE = "https://api.box.com/2.0"

def api(method, url, body=None):
    cmd = ["curl", "-s", "-X", method, url, "-H", "Authorization: Bearer " + TOKEN]
    if body is not None:
        cmd += ["-H", "Content-Type: application/json", "-d", json.dumps(body)]
    out = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    return json.loads(out)

# Recursively gather all files
folder_queue = ["0"]
files = []  # list of (id, name, created_at, created_by_name)

while folder_queue:
    fid = folder_queue.pop(0)
    offset = 0
    while True:
        data = api("GET", f"{BASE}/folders/{fid}/items?limit=1000&offset={offset}")
        for e in data.get("entries", []):
            if e["type"] == "folder":
                folder_queue.append(e["id"])
            elif e["type"] == "file":
                files.append((e["id"], e["name"], None, None))
        offset += data.get("limit", 100)
        if offset >= data.get("total_count", 0):

print(f"Total files found: {len(files)}", file=sys.stderr)

# For each file, fetch full metadata
